title: LOBERT: Generative AI Foundation Model for Limit Order Book Messages
abstract: arXiv:2511.12563v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modeling the dynamics of financial Limit Order Books (LOB) at the message level is challenging due to irregular event timing, rapid regime shifts, and the reactions of high-frequency traders to visible order flow. Previous LOB models require cumbersome data representations and lack adaptability outside their original tasks, leading us to introduce LOBERT, a general-purpose encoder-only foundation model for LOB data suitable for downstream fine-tuning. LOBERT adapts the original BERT architecture for LOB data by using a novel tokenization scheme that treats complete multi-dimensional messages as single tokens while retaining continuous representations of price, volume, and time. With these methods, LOBERT achieves leading performance in tasks such as predicting mid-price movements and next messages, while reducing the required context length compared to previous methods.

translated_title: LOBERT：面向限价订单簿消息的生成式AI基础模型
translated_abstract: 在消息层面建模金融限价订单簿（LOB）的动态变化具有挑战性，原因在于事件发生时间不规则、市场状态快速转换，以及高频交易者对可见订单流的反应。以往的LOB模型需要繁琐的数据表示方式，且在原始任务之外缺乏适应性。为此，我们提出了LOBERT，一个通用的仅编码器（encoder-only）基础模型，适用于LOB数据并支持下游微调。LOBERT通过适配原始BERT架构来处理LOB数据，采用了一种新颖的分词方案，将完整的多维消息作为单个token处理，同时保留价格、成交量和时间的连续表示。凭借这些方法，LOBERT在预测中间价变动和下一条消息等任务中取得了领先性能，同时相比以往方法减少了所需的上下文长度。
tldr: LOBERT是一种针对限价订单簿消息的通用仅编码器基础模型，通过将完整多维消息作为单一token的新颖分词方案，在中间价变动和下一条消息预测等任务中取得领先性能，且所需上下文长度更短。
en_tdlr: LOBERT is a general-purpose encoder-only foundation model for limit order book messages that employs a novel tokenization scheme treating complete multi-dimensional messages as single tokens, achieving leading performance in mid-price movement and next-message prediction tasks with reduced context length.
